enabledLabel: Serve originals for character avatars (master switch)
bgLabel: Also replace background thumbnails (off by default to save bandwidth)
sharpenLabel: Light sharpening: slight contrast / saturation boost (optional)
hint: This extension works in the browser only: it swaps 96×144 thumbnails for originals. If avatars are still blurry because the upload itself was compressed, follow the server-side config.yaml guide in the README.
